task_completion.description: Create a training routine named 'Hotel Gym Full Body'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A routine list or detail page showing the name 'Hotel Gym Full Body'.

task_completion.description: Create a training day named 'Full Body Circuit' within the routine.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The routine detail page showing a day or tab labeled 'Full Body Circuit'.

task_completion.description: Add 5 distinct exercises to the training day.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Full Body Circuit' day view showing exactly 5 unique exercise entries.

task_completion.description: Ensure all 5 exercises use only 'Dumbbell' or 'Cable' equipment, with at least one of each present.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The exercise list or individual exercise detail icons/text showing 'Dumbbell' and 'Cable' as the equipment; no other equipment types (like Barbell) should be visible.

task_completion.description: Configure each of the 5 exercises for 3 sets.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The routine or day view showing '3' in the sets column/field for all 5 exercises.

task_completion.description: Configure each of the 5 exercises for 12 repetitions.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The routine or day view showing '12' in the repetitions column/field for all 5 exercises.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than direct database manipulation or API calls via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with form fields, buttons, and dropdowns in the wger browser interface.

integrity.description: The agent searched for and selected real exercises from the wger database that match the equipment criteria.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the exercise search/selection modal or list being used to filter for dumbbell/cable exercises.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the application menus rather than jumping directly to final state URLs if not provided.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequence of screenshots showing navigation from the dashboard to the routine management section.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The routine must be named 'Hotel Gym Full Body' and the day 'Full Body Circuit'. There must be exactly 5 exercises. Every exercise must have 3 sets and 12 reps. Allowed equipment is strictly 'Dumbbell' or 'Cable'. At least one exercise must be a 'Dumbbell' exercise and at least one must be a 'Cable' exercise. Any other equipment (Barbell, Machine, Kettlebell, Bodyweight) is a failure.
